altText: Nested invented gate boxes show 12,000 recorded events, 10,000 quality-selected recovered cells, 1,000 T-cell events and 100 reagent-binding events. Debris, pairs and dead-cell events are excluded before the recovered-cell denominator. The same 100 binding events are 10% of 1,000 T cells and 1% of 10,000 recovered cells. Box areas are not proportional. No concentration, whole-body count or killing result is inferred.
caption: The same 100 binding events are 10% of the selected T-cell parent and 1% of recovered cells; the nested invented counts define each denominator.
